high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article from the NDTV website, displayed on a mobile device. The time at the top of the screen shows 6:38, with a 5G signal and a partially charged battery icon indicating the device's status. The main content of the article is titled "New Delhi: Iran has opened its otherwise closed airspace exclusively for Indian evacuation flights." It mentions that at least 1,000 Indian students stranded in conflict-hit Iranian cities are expected to land in Delhi within the next two days as part of the government's emergency evacuation program, Operation Sindhu.
